title: Pluto
subtitle: A small world with a big heart
yt_title: Pluto Has a Giant Heart ❤️ | Ep. 8 #shorts
description:
Episode 8 of a daily journey through the universe. ❤️
We reach Pluto: smaller than our Moon, a heart of frozen nitrogen the size of Texas, mountains of water ice, and a spacecraft that carried its discoverer along.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 9: Next stop, Voyager 1. The farthest object humans have ever made.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Images: NASA (public domain)
Narration: AI voice

#space #pluto #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Pluto is smaller than our own Moon. In two thousand six, it was reclassified as a dwarf planet.
segments.headline: Smaller than our Moon

segments.text: But look closer. That bright heart is a giant plain of frozen nitrogen, about the size of Texas.
segments.headline: A heart of frozen nitrogen

segments.text: It also has mountains of water ice, as tall as the Rocky Mountains.
segments.headline: Mountains of ice

segments.text: Sunlight takes about five and a half hours to reach Pluto.
The New Horizons spacecraft took nine and a half years to get here, flying past in twenty fifteen.
And on board, it carries some of the ashes of Clyde Tombaugh, the man who discovered Pluto.
segments.headline: Its discoverer came along

segments.text: Tomorrow, we chase the farthest thing humans have ever made. Next stop: Voyager one, out in interstellar space. Follow, so you don't miss episode nine.
